fusions.name: Barbed Lunge
fusions.desc: Sends a barb at the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Reeled In
fusions.desc: You are hauled up to 7 tiles to the target and strike it for 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It also has a 60% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag and Pull
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Trophy Taking
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds and you gain +6% dodge chance. Once every 8 seconds.
